notes: New in 2.3.5: reactions are real reactions now. Sometimes your WhatsApp Agent typed a ✅ at the top of its reply instead of reacting. Now it puts the ✅ (or 👍, ❤️…) on your message, small in the corner, like a person reacting. Its reply keeps just the words. Emoji inside normal sentences stay as they are. If Settings → Channels → WhatsApp Agent → Reactions is "Off", the stray emoji is just left out of the reply. Nothing to set up: it works after you update.
